credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Transparent glass carafe that has an hour glass shape. Around the middle is are two wooden semi-circles secured by a brown leather string tied in a knot. The top has a small convex lip for pouring. Bottom has three rectangular feet. Midway through the bottom of carafe is a convex circle, much like a button.
